evidence: CVE.org https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-75919 is state=PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn). CWE-306. Affected semver <4.1.7; 4.1.7 unaffected. Description: unauthenticated SetupController POST /api/setup/update-database and POST /api/setup/backup while maintenance mode is enabled.

Vendor advisory https://github.com/thorsten/phpMyFAQ/security/advisories/GHSA-f96w-7fx2-79c8 is published (Aug 4, 2026), affected <= v4.1.6, patched 4.1.7. GitHub Advisory Database GHSA-gjx5-c2mr-w8c7 has withdrawn_at=null.

At tag 4.1.6 (58c1d7f2fa36f7074664fc6d862afee0ca8bcc89) phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Controller/Api/SetupController.php overrides isSecured() as a no-op; backup() calls Update::createConfigBackup() on content/core/config; updateDatabase() calls Update::applyUpdates() then sets main.maintenanceMode=false. The only runtime gate is checkMaintenanceMode(). AbstractController::isSecured() only enforces security.enableLoginOnly, not administrator authentication.
Tag 4.1.6 phpmyfaq/src/api-routes.php and nginx/.htaccess expose POST setup/check, setup/backup, and setup/update-database through public phpmyfaq/api/index.php, not the admin API.

a32a00a37faa6e5919d18ec72b79e150656ee1ab (single parent 414eb183793bd702bac8cea61280cf8d624795c5) first adds phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Controller/SetupController.php and the public POST api/setup/update rewrite/route. The new controller's update() calls Update::applyUpdates() with no authentication, CSRF, token, or maintenance-mode check.

Earlier #2492 work c297cd9ee14137eb38a535a20276335bc76902f2 / c8c31b7d84f34adbcc991061284d8effe92adf7c added admin-routes UpdateController surfaces (admin/api/update-database, admin backup), not the public SetupController route named by the advisory.

75062f0d186369d4de0294775dad3c019c03ebb1 rewrites the same unauthenticated controller into setup/check, setup/backup, and setup/update-database (the advisory sinks). b8d628d65bf7aaff94069d18306d6b0bbf41817c later adds the explicit empty isSecured() override. Both are descendants of the first public applyUpdates writer, not the BIC.
git ls-tree -r --name-only 414eb183793bd702bac8cea61280cf8d624795c5 has no phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Controller/SetupController.php (only classic phpmyfaq/setup/update.php and Setup/* helpers).

git grep of 414eb183793bd702bac8cea61280cf8d624795c5 on api-routes.php, admin-routes.php, nginx.conf, and phpmyfaq/.htaccess finds zero setup/update or SetupController public-route hits. The same paths at a32a00a37faa6e5919d18ec72b79e150656ee1ab contain the route, rewrite, and applyUpdates call.

git cat-file -p a32a00a37faa6e5919d18ec72b79e150656ee1ab records exactly one parent 414eb183793bd702bac8cea61280cf8d624795c5; it is not a merge. GitHub issue #2492 is a feature issue, not a squash-merged PR (pulls/2492 404).

Public history records ordinary sequential commits for the same issue, including a32a00a37faa6e5919d18ec72b79e150656ee1ab then f4ce7a104f6d832478d323defbadc5c936b4a9b6 then 75062f0d186369d4de0294775dad3c019c03ebb1. The first public SetupController/route member is a32a00a37faa6e5919d18ec72b79e150656ee1ab itself, not a squash aggregate.

git merge-base --is-ancestor a32a00a37faa6e5919d18ec72b79e150656ee1ab succeeds for tags 4.0.0-alpha (1edda28c3dd34a919263827aaedbb957b099fbbc), 4.0.0 (9bf3d792e67da3c04217002a9642fdf74ced9554), 4.1.1 (f791858b2aa4b811f5b19d10c20ba5c4a30786de), and 4.1.6 (58c1d7f2fa36f7074664fc6d862afee0ca8bcc89). git log 4.1.6..4.1.7 -- phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Controller/Api/SetupController.php contains only d6a6a033ee788727c0e6ceaaeee16b9b537c67e7 (subject: fix: prevented unauthenticated database migration via the setup API; single parent ad858dfb3a55e84ce69879a4a4c73c83be2eae97).

That commit adds denyUnauthorizedRequest() at the start of check(), backup(), and updateDatabase(), accepting only a logged-in super-admin / CONFIGURATION_EDIT user or a valid filesystem-backed x-pmf-update-token, and changes the backup response from a full path to basename().

GitHub commit API maps both author and committer to user login thorsten (type=User, id=45284), single parent 414eb183793bd702bac8cea61280cf8d624795c5. Attribution uses only this BIC object; later Rector/isSecured commits were not used as introducers.

findings: Real CWE-306: at 4.1.6 the public Setup API runs config backup and database migration (and then disables maintenance mode) for unauthenticated callers whenever main.maintenanceMode is true.

Smallest surviving public BIC is a32a00a37faa6e5919d18ec72b79e150656ee1ab, which first wrote SetupController and POST /api/setup/update calling applyUpdates() without auth. Immediate parent 414eb183793bd702bac8cea61280cf8d624795c5 lacks that controller and route.

75062f0d186369d4de0294775dad3c019c03ebb1 is a scope-expanding descendant (backup + update-database rewrite). b8d628d65bf7aaff94069d18306d6b0bbf41817c only no-ops inherited enableLoginOnly; it is not the first missing-auth write.
Direct fix is d6a6a033ee788727c0e6ceaaeee16b9b537c67e7, present in tag 4.1.7 and absent from tag 4.1.6.

BIC author/committer is named maintainer Thorsten Rinne / GitHub user thorsten with no AI/bot/generator marker, so the closed class is NOT_AI. CVE.org and vendor GHSA-f96w-7fx2-79c8 are published, so this is not FALSE_POSITIVE.
